# AppDirectory
> Curated directory of verified open-source and privacy-respecting software applications.

## Directory Overview
AppDirectory provides transparent access to telemetry-free desktop and mobile applications.
- [Home Page](https://example.com/index.html): Full searchable directory of curated tools.
- [About AppDirectory](https://example.com/about.html): Curation standards and editorial guidelines.
- [Contact & Submissions](https://example.com/contact.html): Suggest software or contact contributors.
- [Privacy Policy](https://example.com/privacy.html): Our zero-tracking privacy policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://example.com/terms.html): Open-source directory terms of use.

## Curated Applications
- [VSCodium](https://example.com/apps/vscodium.html): Telemetry-free open-source binary distributions of VS Code. (Development • MIT)
- [Obsidian Notes](https://example.com/apps/obsidian.html): Extensible Markdown knowledge base and personal wiki. (Productivity • Freeware)
- [Bitwarden](https://example.com/apps/bitwarden.html): Open-source password manager with zero-knowledge encryption. (Security • GPLv3)
- [VLC Media Player](https://example.com/apps/vlc.html): Universal multimedia player supporting virtually all formats. (Media • GNU LGPL)
- [Signal Messenger](https://example.com/apps/signal.html): Private, state-of-the-art end-to-end encrypted messaging. (Security • GPLv3)
- [7-Zip Utility](https://example.com/apps/7zip.html): High compression ratio file archiver with AES-256 encryption. (Utilities • GNU LGPL)
- [Kdenlive Video Editor](https://example.com/apps/kdenlive.html): Multi-track non-linear video editing suite with hardware acceleration. (Media • GPLv3)
- [Syncthing](https://example.com/apps/syncthing.html): Continuous decentralized peer-to-peer file synchronization. (Utilities • MPL-2.0)
- [Hoppscotch](https://example.com/apps/hoppscotch.html): Lightweight, privacy-focused open source API development ecosystem. (Development • MIT)

## Optional Context & Full Documentation
- [XML Sitemap](https://example.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all pages.
